description: Fleet dashboard for one or more sp-rtk-base base stations. The Fleet overview at the top has one row per base, worst Base health first, and ignores the Base selector. The rows below follow the Base selector ($base). Pick a Prometheus datasource; the scrape job must be named sp-rtk-base and carry a base label.

panels.description: One row per base, whatever the Base selector says, worst Base health first. Base health and every threshold: see docs/monitoring/README.md, Base health. Anchored on Prometheus's scrape status for the sp-rtk-base job, so a base it can't scrape stays as Down. Click a base to select it.

targets.expr:
max by (base) (
    label_replace(3 * (up{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 0), "check", "down", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (sp_rtk_base_relay_running{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 0), "check", "relay", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (sp_rtk_base_input_connected{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 0), "check", "input", "", "")
  or label_replace(2 * (sp_rtk_base_input_seconds_since_last_data{job="sp-rtk-base"} > bool 60), "check", "rtcm", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_signal_quality{job="sp-rtk-base"} >= bool 1, "check", "signal_quality", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_active_destinations{job="sp-rtk-base"} < bool sp_rtk_base_total_destinations{job="sp-rtk-base"}, "check", "destinations", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_bluetooth_link_strength{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 2, "check", "bluetooth", "", "")
  or label_replace((sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength{job="sp-rtk-base"} == bool 2) * on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} == bool 1), "check", "wifi_uplink", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_host_cpu_temperature_celsius{job="sp-rtk-base"} >= bool 80, "check", "cpu_temperature", "", "")
  or label_replace(increase(sp_rtk_base_host_undervoltage_events_total{job="sp-rtk-base"}[1h]) > bool 0, "check", "undervoltage", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_host_memory_available_bytes{job="sp-rtk-base"} / sp_rtk_base_host_memory_total_bytes{job="sp-rtk-base"} < bool 0.1, "check", "memory", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_host_root_filesystem_available_bytes{job="sp-rtk-base"} / sp_rtk_base_host_root_filesystem_size_bytes{job="sp-rtk-base"} < bool 0.1, "check", "root_filesystem", "", "")
)

max by (base, destinations) (
  label_join(
      count_values by (base) ("active", sp_rtk_base_active_destinations{job="sp-rtk-base"})
    * on (base) group_left (total)
      count_values by (base) ("total", sp_rtk_base_total_destinations{job="sp-rtk-base"}),
    "destinations", "/", "active", "total"
  )
)

max by (base, uplink) (
    label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="ethernet"} == 1, "uplink", "Ethernet", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} == 1, "uplink", "Wi-Fi", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_uplink_other{job="sp-rtk-base"} == 1, "uplink", "Other", "", "")
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_uplink_other{job="sp-rtk-base"} != sp_rtk_base_network_uplink_other{job="sp-rtk-base"}, "uplink", "No reading", "", "")
)

max by (base, wifi) (topk by (base) (1, max by (base, interface, wifi) (
    label_join(
        label_join(
            count_values without () ("dbm", sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base"} == sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base"})
          * on (base, interface) group_left (band) sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_band{job="sp-rtk-base"},
          "wifi", " dBm · ", "dbm", "band"
        )
      * on (base, interface) group_left (role) (
            label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} == 0, "role", " · not Uplink", "", "")
          or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_uplink{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} != 0, "role", "", "", "")
        ),
      "wifi", "", "wifi", "role"
    )
  or label_replace(sp_rtk_base_network_link_up{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} == 0, "wifi", "Disconnected", "", "")
  or label_replace((sp_rtk_base_network_link_up{job="sp-rtk-base", kind="wifi"} != 0) unless on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_band{job="sp-rtk-base"} and on (base, interface) (sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base"} == sp_rtk_base_wifi_link_strength_dbm{job="sp-rtk-base"})), "wifi", "No reading", "", "")
)))

panels.title: Fleet overview

panels.description: Green when the most recent sample arrived within the last 2 minutes — the canonical 'is the push pipeline still alive' signal.  Goes red whenever the base is offline, the host is down, or the home receiver is broken.
panels.title: Pipeline Freshness

panels.description: 1 = relay engine running, 0 = stopped.
panels.title: Relay Running

panels.description: 1 = input source connected (TCP/serial/Bluetooth open), 0 = disconnected.
panels.title: Input Source

panels.description: Connected destination count out of total registered.
panels.title: Destinations Active / Total

panels.description: How long the relay engine has been continuously running.
panels.title: Relay Uptime

panels.description: How well the antenna hears the satellites, exactly as the Signal Quality card on the dashboard and survey-in pages shows it (smoothed over 10 s, deadbanded). NO DATA while the Relay is stopped and no receiver is connected, or while no MSM / Signal Snapshot is arriving.
panels.title: Signal Quality

panels.description: Band strength: mean C/N0 of the 4 strongest signals in each band. Green lines mark the Good thresholds: 41 dB-Hz for L2, 44 dB-Hz for L1. Gaps mean no data.
panels.title: Band strength (L1 / L2)

panels.description: Usable satellites: satellites with a signal at 35 dB-Hz or more. Reference lines at 10 (Marginal) and 15 (Good).
panels.title: Usable satellites

panels.description: Rate of RTCM bytes arriving from the GPS input source.  Primary 'is data flowing' signal — should be non-zero and stable while the GPS is feeding.
panels.title: Input bytes/s (RTCM in)

panels.description: Internal hub-processing rates.  Frames Parsed is the RTCM-decoding rate; Chunks Distributed is the per-second hand-off to destinations.  They should track each other closely; a large gap (parsed >> distributed) means destinations aren't keeping up.
panels.title: Hub processing rate (frames + chunks)

panels.description: Seconds since the GPS sent its last byte.  Climbs ~1 per second when the GPS goes silent.  Stays under a few seconds during normal operation.
panels.title: Seconds Since Last RTCM

panels.description: Snapshot per destination across selected base stations.  Connected/Errors/Queue are colour-coded; bytes are formatted human-readable.
panels.title: Destination Status

panels.description: Bytes/s being sent to each destination.  Tracks input * (active destinations).  Zero on a destination = it's either disconnected or paused.
panels.title: Bytes/s per destination

panels.description: Messages/s being sent to each destination.  Useful when destinations have different filter policies and bytes/s diverges.
panels.title: Messages/s per destination

panels.description: Per-destination drop rate — messages discarded because the destination's outbound queue was full.  Should be 0; sustained non-zero means the destination is consistently slower than the input.
panels.title: Drops/s per destination

panels.description: Per-destination queue depth.  Non-zero = momentarily buffered (fine); sustained climb = destination not keeping up.
panels.title: Queue depth per destination

panels.description: 1 = connected, 0 = disconnected, per destination over time.  Drops to 0 indicate a flap.
panels.title: Destinations connected over time

panels.description: Rate of errors per destination.  Spikes indicate an output misbehaving (NTRIP caster down, SurePath auth expired, TCP server saturated).
panels.title: Destination errors/s

panels.description: Live logs from sp-rtk-base.service, filtered by the $base selector at the top.  Requires logs to be shipped to Loki with at least the `base` and `service` labels set — see the README in this directory for the agent-side recipe.
panels.title: Logs · sp-rtk-base.service
